validation_method: Verse-granularity comparison vs Madueke_A (modern-spelling, same edition). Both sides skeleton-folded (small-caps, long-s, ae/oe, u->v, i->j, y->i, vv->w, &->and, doubled-letter collapse, silent trailing -e) so archaic<->modern SPELLING does not count as a mismatch — only genuine WORDING differs. 'folded_agreement' is per-verse (penalized by versification differences); 'chapter_bag_agreement' is whole-chapter bag-of-words (versification-insensitive) — the gap between them isolates verse-boundary differences from text loss.
